title: Canada's Carney Mocks Trump After Teleprompter Glitch
summary: During a public event, Canada's Governor of the Bank of Canada, Stephen Carney, experienced a teleprompter malfunction. Following the glitch, Carney made remarks that were interpreted as mocking U.S. President Donald Trump. The incident occurred during a public appearance where the teleprompter failed, leading to Carney's impromptu commentary. Both The Print and Reuters reported on the event, highlighting Carney's reaction to the technical issue.
summary_points: Stephen Carney, Governor of the Bank of Canada, faced a teleprompter glitch during a public event.
Following the glitch, Carney made remarks interpreted as mocking U.S. President Donald Trump.
The incident occurred during a public appearance.
The Print and Reuters reported on the event.
